basic_details.job_title: Orissa High Court Civil Judge Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for 30 Posts
basic_details.short_information: Only serving Judicial Officers in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division) who have completed three years of qualifying service as on 01.04.2026 can apply. The High Court of Orissa, Cuttack will fill 30 (Thirty) vacancies of Civil Judge (Senior Division) through the Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026 under Advertisement No. 05 of 2026. The pay scale is ₹1,11,000 – ₹1,63,030 with usual D.A. and other allowances. Applications are online only on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in from 10:00 A.M. of 09.11.2026 till 11:59 P.M. of 25.11.2026.

important_dates.date and time of each stage of examinati: To be notified on the High Court of Orissa website

how_to_apply: Applications are accepted only online, from 10:00 A.M. of 09.11.2026 till 11:59 P.M. of 25.11.2026.
Go through the advertisement and the "Instructions to Candidates and Process Flow for Filling up of Online Application Form" on the Court's website before filling the form.
Log in to the website of the High Court of Orissa, www.orissahighcourt.nic.in.
Open Recruitment Corner, then Examination Portal, then "Limited Departmental Competitive Examination for Recruitment to the Posts in the Cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division), 2026".
Fill in the online application form within the due date and time, under intimation to your concerned Controlling Authority.
Upload the two documents named in the notice (listed below).
Recent passport size colour photograph. The photograph must be clearly visible with proper orientation.
Full signature with proper orientation. The signature must be clearly visible with proper orientation and on a white background.

Incomplete or incorrect applications, and forms submitted through modes other than the prescribed online format, will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected without assigning any reason. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest application, the one with the higher Acknowledgement Number, will be considered.

For guidance on the online application, applicants may contact the Recruitment Cell of the Court on Mobile Number 9437498780 or e-mail [email protected]. Help is available on working days between 10:30 A.M. and 04:30 P.M., from the opening date to the closing date of the application form.
important_instructions: Admission to any stage of the process will be provisional. If a candidate is found at any stage not to fulfil the eligibility conditions, the candidature will be liable for rejection. If a candidate fails to attend any stage of the examination, the candidature shall be rejected. No T.A. / D.A. will be paid for appearing in the examination. The list of eligible applicants shall be published on the Court's website / Notice Board. No Admission Letter for any stage will be sent by post. Exam dates and the e-Admit Card will be available on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The number of vacancies is subject to change at the discretion of the Court. The Court reserves the right to cancel the entire recruitment process or any part of it at any stage without assigning any reason, and its decision shall be final.

content_sections.heading: About Orissa High Court Civil Judge (Senior Division)
content_sections.text: The High Court of Orissa at Cuttack conducts this recruitment through its Registrar, Examination. The Limited Departmental Competitive Examination, 2026 fills vacancies in the cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division) on the basis of merit from among officers already serving as Civil Judge (Junior Division). The recruitment is conducted under the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007 and the amendments made to them.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: This is an in-service examination. The notice invites applications only from eligible Judicial Officers in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division). Open-market candidates are not invited. Qualifying service: an officer must have completed three years of qualifying service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) as on 01.04.2026. How service is counted: the date of entry into judicial service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) will be taken into consideration for calculating the three years. Intimation: officers must apply under intimation to their concerned Controlling Authorities. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification, as eligibility rests on service in the Civil Judge (Junior Division) cadre. The notice prints no age limit. Candidates should check the official notification and the O.S.J.S. and O.J.S. Rules, 2007 for the full eligibility conditions.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The scale of pay for Civil Judge (Senior Division) is ₹1,11,000 – ₹1,63,030 with usual D.A. and other allowances as admissible from time to time. Every candidate promoted to the posts in the cadre of Civil Judge (Senior Division) through this examination shall be on probation as per Rule 33 of the O.S.J.S. & O.J.S. Rules, 2007.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for Orissa High Court Civil Judge (Senior Division)
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted only online, from 10:00 A.M. of 09.11.2026 till 11:59 P.M. of 25.11.2026. Recent passport size colour photograph. The photograph must be clearly visible with proper orientation. Full signature with proper orientation. The signature must be clearly visible with proper orientation and on a white background. Incomplete or incorrect applications, and forms submitted through modes other than the prescribed online format, will not be entertained and will be summarily rejected without assigning any reason. If a candidate submits more than one application, only the latest application, the one with the higher Acknowledgement Number, will be considered. For guidance on the online application, applicants may contact the Recruitment Cell of the Court on Mobile Number 9437498780 or e-mail [email protected] . Help is available on working days between 10:30 A.M. and 04:30 P.M., from the opening date to the closing date of the application form.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Selection has three parts: a written examination of two papers, a viva-voce, and an evaluation of CCRs / PARs / ACRs. A merit list is then drawn up. The written examination has two papers. Each paper carries 100 marks and lasts 2 (Two) hours. The 40-mark part of Paper-1 also covers: The Odisha Consolidation of Holding and Prevention of Fragmentation of Land Act The Odisha Estate Abolition Act and The Odisha Land Reforms Act The Arbitration and Conciliation Act and The Commercial Courts Act The Odisha Survey and Settlement Act and The Odisha Prevention of Land Encroachment Act The Odisha Hindu Religious Endowments Act The 25-mark special Acts part of Paper-2 covers: The Food Safety and Standard Act, 2006 and The Essential Commodities Act The Environment Protection Act and The Water (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1974 The Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005 The Juvenile Justice (Care and Protection of Children) Act The Protection of Children from Sexual Offences (POCSO) Act Candidates who secure a minimum of 50 per cent of marks in aggregate in both written papers, and not less than 45 per cent of marks in each individual written paper, shall be called for the viva-voce test. The candidate's CCRs / PARs / ACRs for the three years immediately preceding the year of examination shall be evaluated. This evaluation carries 15 marks. The final selection shall be made on the basis of the total marks obtained in the written test, the viva-voce test and the evaluation of CCRs/PARs/ACRs. A candidate shall not be selected unless he or she secures 40% of marks in the viva-voce test.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in Orissa High Court Civil Judge (Senior Division) LDCE 2026?
faq.answer: There are 30 (Thirty) vacancies of Civil Judge (Senior Division) under Advertisement No. 05 of 2026. The number is subject to change at the discretion of the Court.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The online application closes at 11:59 P.M. on 25 November 2026. It opens at 10:00 A.M. on 9 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. Who is eligible to apply?
faq.answer: Only Judicial Officers in the cadre of Civil Judge (Junior Division) can apply, and they must have completed three years of qualifying service as Civil Judge (Junior Division) as on 01.04.2026. The service is counted from the date of entry into judicial service as Civil Judge (Junior Division).

faq.question: Q4. What is the pay scale of Civil Judge (Senior Division)?
faq.answer: The scale of pay is ₹1,11,000 – ₹1,63,030 with usual D.A. and other allowances as admissible from time to time.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Apply online on www.orissahighcourt.nic.in via Recruitment Corner, then Examination Portal, then the Civil Judge (Senior Division) LDCE 2026 link, under intimation to your Controlling Authority. You must upload a passport size colour photograph and your full signature.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: Selection is through a written examination of two papers of 100 marks each, a viva-voce of 30 marks and an evaluation of CCRs / PARs / ACRs of 15 marks. The final merit list is based on the total marks of all three.

faq.question: Q7. What marks are needed to be called for the viva-voce?
faq.answer: A candidate needs at least 50 per cent marks in aggregate in both written papers and not less than 45 per cent in each paper. To be selected, a candidate must also secure 40% of marks in the viva-voce.

faq.question: Q8. When will the examination be held?
faq.answer: The notice says that the date and time of each stage of the examination will be published on the website of the High Court of Orissa. No admission letter will be sent by post.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if I submit more than one application?
faq.answer: Only the information in the latest application, the one with the higher Acknowledgement Number, will be considered.

faq.question: Q10. Will travelling allowance be paid for the examination?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no T.A. / D.A. will be paid for appearing in the examination.
